question: Do frozen-Encoder predictive states retain information and improve fixed-coordinate temporal prediction over equally informed direct-embedding controls?
executionBoundary: This registration permits source implementation and synthetic engineering witnesses. Market capture and fitting require the separately recorded current-chain, source-closure, control and chronology gates. This task performs no market fitting, Encoder updates or independent confirmation.

admission.sourcePolicy: Use only the exact existing raw CSV/CACHE88 bytes and semantic order recorded in the admission receipt. Never rebuild a cache or extend the population implicitly.
admission.availability: ASSUMED zero receipt latency after a completed candle: available_ms=close_time_ms; decision_ms=close_time_ms. This is a conditional historical observation model, not measured feed or live execution latency.
admission.encoderExposure: January 1-21 2024 contributed to Encoder fitting; January 22-28 was previously development-exposed. Every result under this card is conditional development evidence.
admission.unassigned: January 29-31 and all new periods remain unassigned and unopened for quality evaluation. No TEST role is admitted.
admission.populationRule: Purge the complete raw envelope at each role boundary; require every semantic channel and all history/future support to be available, finite and complete. Use the same intersection of legal origins for every compared method at each horizon and observable. Retain exclusions and their reasons. Duplicate horizons do not create distinct covariance origins.

encoder.policy: Frozen weights and fitted statistics, zero updates/refits. A disclosed convenience baseline with mixed measured retention, not a selected research winner. New candidates require a new campaign and compatible captures.

stateStudy.stateArchitecture: TRAIN-normalized embedding followed by same-width affine map, identity weight and zero bias initialization
stateStudy.targetArchitecture: Exact detached initial copy of online State Representation Network; EMA follows successful updates only, never optimized directly
stateStudy.dynamicsArchitecture: One affine residual prediction per horizon on complete oldest-first K4 state history; zero learned weight and bias initialization; no rollout
stateStudy.transformPopulation: Equal-weight unique complete mature representation-TRAIN windows; freeze input mean/std and the initial state reference scales before updates
stateStudy.sampling: Fixed seeded replacement sampling of eligible TRAIN transition origins; a separate graph-preserving covariance pool contains 256 distinct eligible TRAIN origins each update
stateStudy.skipPolicy: All-invalid updates change neither AdamW nor online/dynamics/EMA state; retain attempted/completed/sampler counters
stateStudy.matching: Match all arms' initialization, data, seed index, updates, non-predictive loss, covariance pool policy and EMA schedule; only declared prediction-gradient routing differs

directEmbeddingControls.coordinates: Exact frozen native Encoder embedding coordinate identity; no state-space loss ranking across different encoders

ridge.policy: One complete TRAIN-only fit per history and horizon; include fitted means/transforms in artifact identity

residualMlp.architecture: Independent Linear(144,32)-tanh-Linear(32,36) for each horizon; no dropout, normalization layers, recurrence or shared learned parameters
residualMlp.initialization: Local seeded generator: first-layer Xavier uniform gain1, first bias zero, output weight/bias zero. Initial prediction equals persistence. No global RNG mutation.
residualMlp.horizonSeedRule: Initialize and sample each horizon with the declared repetition seed plus its positive horizon in a separately serialized local engine; preserve the exact rule in canonical configuration
residualMlp.fittingPopulation: Exactly the baseline-eligible complete/mature TRAIN associations for that horizon and K4 history. No held-out values, targets or masks enter fitting or transform statistics.
residualMlp.inputTransform: Per-horizon sample-weighted flattened-history mean and population standard deviation, floor1e-8, fitted once from admitted TRAIN associations
residualMlp.residualScale: Per-horizon sample-weighted sqrt(mean((e_future-e_last)^2)) for each coordinate, floor1e-8, fitted once from admitted TRAIN associations
residualMlp.objective: Sample-weighted mean squared (prediction-e_future)/residual_scale over coordinates and sampled rows; uniform replacement row sampling; normalize by sampled weight sum times36
residualMlp.stopping: Exactly the registered update budget, no validation selection, seed selection, early stopping, hyperparameter search or rescue
residualMlp.artifactPolicy: Immutable inference and exact-resume artifacts with all parameters, frozen transforms, canonical recipe, coordinate identity, source/module and Encoder parent, fit population/cutoff. Comparison receipts pin ModelRef, sidecar and prediction hashes. Changed kind/state/configuration/parent/control or missing trusted pin is rejected before scoring.
residualMlp.publicationOwner: Latent State Learning shared study publishes every declared fitted repetition and its frozen prediction output; downstream consumers cannot refit or substitute it
residualMlp.engineeringWitnesses: Small separately identified artificial populations and budgets may test gradients, learning, exact resume, eligibility, causal issuance and corruption rejection. These witnesses do not fit this market recipe or settle point skill.

retentionAndDiversity.probeReference: Unchanged MKT-HIST-2 target definitions from the preserved CPB-v3 reports; evaluate newly fitted probes on matched admitted development populations, never transplant historical scores

heads.optimizer: Adam lr0.01 beta0.9/0.999 eps1e-8, full-batch100 updates

retentionAndDiversity.retentionRule: For each fixed observable and head family, the upper simultaneous95% confidence bound on relative normalized MSE degradation versus the same frozen-Encoder probe is at most0.05; insufficient reference variance or support is inconclusive
retentionAndDiversity.policy: Freeze external probe targets/recipes and report all tasks, arms and seeds; covariance regularization or low latent loss alone cannot establish retained information

riskComparisonRegistration.dispersionFormula: Population std of all128 adjacent future one-minute log close returns, including the first return from the observed origin close; units one-minute logreturn, no annualization or sqrt(R) scaling
riskComparisonRegistration.downsideFormula: max(0,-min_{j=1..128} log(close[t+j]/close[t])); units logreturn; not peak-to-trough drawdown
featureArms: K4 e plus predicted e from K4 ridge
K4 e plus predicted e from registered residual-MLP
K4 e plus predicted target z
K4 online z plus predicted target z

conventional.rule: Same permitted raw envelope and observable units; no extra context or future information

riskComparisonRegistration.placebo: Append108 standard-normal label-independent coordinates generated by a local hash of seed944501, immutable origin ID and coordinate; same declared readout recipe and row intersection
riskComparisonRegistration.fitPolicy: Representation/control fits end before every risk-TRAIN issued feature; risk targets mature by January25 end. Evaluation origins follow risk-head cutoff. No retrospective representation-TRAIN forecasts are risk-TRAIN inputs.
riskComparisonRegistration.publication: All fitted controls and risk recipes need complete immutable state/parent/coordinate/output comparison pins; implementation and synthetic protocol witnesses remain prerequisites, not inferred capabilities

decisions.pointSkill: For each frozen target-state checkpoint, map every native-e control forecast through that exact frozen target affine map and score against its future target-state output, with the same reference scales, origins and horizons. Support only when the simultaneous95% lower confidence bound on relative MSE reduction versus the strongest declared mean/persistence/K1/K4/residual-MLP control exceeds0.05; report every horizon and reference. Native-e losses are reported separately. Do not compare raw e and z MSE or latent losses from different target checkpoints as if coordinates were identical.
decisions.stateOnly: Independently preregistered branch: retained/diverse state plus supported common-observable utility can remain eligible when point skill is negative/inconclusive. It never establishes point-forecast skill.
decisions.attribution: Full minus blocked-prediction and full minus frozen-state contrasts must both have simultaneous lower95% bounds above0.05 relative MSE reduction on the same common-observable retention/risk task to attribute a practically useful gain to predictive shaping; different learned target-coordinate latent losses cannot supply this contrast. Otherwise preserve the narrower observed disposition
decisions.riskUtility: For each observable and each state-only/forecast-assisted claim, require the lower simultaneous95% bound on relative normalized MSE reduction over its matched direct-embedding, conventional, capacity and placebo controls to exceed0.05; report the hardest comparator and every reference
decisions.negative: With admitted coverage/support, upper simultaneous confidence bound below the minimum useful effect rules out the declared useful gain; explicit retention/diversity failure rejects state eligibility in this scope
decisions.inconclusive: A confidence interval crossing the useful-effect rule, inadequate coverage/maturity, unsupported variance or insufficient chronology is inconclusive, not negative or favorable
decisions.independentConfirmation: No independent evidence is admitted by this card. Freeze an eligible recipe and register a separate untouched later-source confirmation protocol before opening outcomes; January29-31 is not silently TEST.
decisions.portfolioMateriality: Outside this card: requires its own prospective decision mapping, economic useful-effect threshold, costs/constraints and dependence-aware uncertainty rule before its outcomes; this registration grants no portfolio eligibility
decisions.dataExtension: If minimum support or useful-effect uncertainty cannot be resolved, close the card with its actual shortfall/limits. New data, parameters, budget, seeds or hypothesis require a new prospective identity before outcomes; no automatic experiment escalation.

uncertainty.method: Paired circular moving-block bootstrap on chronological origin-level loss differences; resample whole origin vectors jointly across assets, horizons, arms and methods, preserving paired comparisons
uncertainty.multiplicity: Fixed Bonferroni family cap256: alpha0.05/256 for every registered claim contrast/observable/horizon. Enumerate the actual contrasts in the execution closure and reject more than256 before fitting; unused slots never relax alpha. Report simultaneous percentile bounds and all per-seed results; average losses across all3 registered seeds before origin-block resampling, no favorable-seed selection
uncertainty.support: Require at least6 complete512-origin evaluation blocks (3072 origins) for a supported/negative simultaneous scientific decision. The admitted4062 complete origins contain7 blocks. Smaller sets may produce estimates but their scientific decisions remain inconclusive. This requirement does not prevent the bounded synthetic control implementation.
